- **Prior year:** In Q1 2025, net earnings attributable to common shareholders were about $6.3 billion.

- **Converting to net income:** GAAP EPS usually runs somewhat below adjusted EPS, so I used about $6.2. Multiplied by roughly 908 million shares, that gives about $5.6–5.7 billion. Including noncontrolling interests would put it a little higher.
